panels.title: Average Server Setup Time by User

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/ZPA* 
| json field=_raw "Username", "ServerSetupTime"
| where username!="ZPA LSS Client"
| avg(ServerSetupTime) as ServerSetupTime_avg by Username
| sort ServerSetupTime_avg desc
| limit 20

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZPA* 
| json field=_raw "Username"
| json field=_raw "ServerSetupTime" nodrop
| json field=_raw "ConnectorZENSetupTime" nodrop
| json field=_raw "ConnectionSetupTime" nodrop
| json field=_raw "AppLearnTime" nodrop
| where username!="ZPA LSS Client" 
| where (!isEmpty(ServerSetupTime) or !isEmpty(ConnectorZENSetupTime) or !isEmpty(ConnectionSetupTime) or !isEmpty(AppLearnTime)) 
| avg(ServerSetupTime) as ServerSetupTime_avg,avg(ConnectorZENSetupTime) as ConnectorZENSetupTime_avg,avg(ConnectionSetupTime) as ConnectionSetupTime_avg,avg(AppLearnTime) as AppLearnTime_avg
| limit 20

panels.title: Untitled
panels.text:
### 1. *ServerSetupTime* : Time in microseconds taken for setting up connection at server.
### 2. *ConnectionSetupTime* : 	Time taken by the App Connector to process a notification from the App Connector selection microservice and set up the connection to the application server.
### 3. *ConnectorZENSetupTime* : Time in microseconds taken for setting up connection between App Connector and ZPA Public Service Edge  or ZPA Private Service Edge.
### 4. *AppLearnTime* : 	Time in microseconds taken for App Connectors to learn about the requested application and report the learned information to the central authority

children.title: ZPA - Users

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/ZPA*  
| json field=_raw "SessionStatus", "Username", "ConnectionStatus" nodrop
| if(isEmpty(SessionStatus), if(isEmpty(ConnectionStatus),"Invalid", ConnectionStatus), SessionStatus) as SessionStatus
| where Username!="ZPA LSS Client"
| withtime SessionStatus
| most_recent(SessionStatus_withtime) as SessionStatus by Username
| where ( SessionStatus="ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED" or SessionStatus = "open" or SessionStatus = "active")
| count

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZPA* 
| json field=_raw "Username"
| json field=_raw "PublicIP", "ClientPublicIP" nodrop
| if(isEmpty(PublicIP), ClientPublicIP, PublicIP) as PublicIP
| where Username!="ZPA LSS Client" and Username matches "{{Username}}"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = PublicIP
| where !isNull(latitude)
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code,Username
| sort _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZPA*  
| json field=_raw "Username"
| json field=_raw "SessionStatus","CountryCode","PublicIP", "ConnectionStatus", "ClientPublicIP", "ClientCountryCode" nodrop
| if(isEmpty(PublicIP), if(isEmpty(ClientPublicIP),"0", ClientPublicIP), PublicIP) as PublicIP
| if(isEmpty(CountryCode), if(isEmpty(ClientCountryCode),"0", ClientCountryCode), CountryCode) as CountryCode
| if(isEmpty(SessionStatus), if(isEmpty(ConnectionStatus),"Invalid", ConnectionStatus), SessionStatus) as SessionStatus
| where Username!="ZPA LSS Client" and Username matches "{{Username}}"
| withtime SessionStatus
| most_recent(SessionStatus_withtime) as SessionStatus by Username,CountryCode,PublicIP
| where ( SessionStatus="ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED" or SessionStatus = "open" or SessionStatus = "active")
| limit 100

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZPA*

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZPA*  
| json field=_raw "Username"
| json field=_raw "PublicIP", "ClientPublicIP" nodrop
